thread.title: Dow Jones Up In Stock Market Today; IBM, Apple Gain | Investor's Business Daily

author: NANCY GONDO
title: Dow Jones Up In Stock Market Today; IBM, Apple Gain | Investor's Business Daily
text:
The stock market today rallied into the close, sending the key market indexes to solid gains and session highs as the midterm elections were underway.
X The Dow Jones industrial average led with a 0.7% surge, while the Nasdaq composite and S&P 500 added 0.6% each. Small caps also participated in the advance, with the Russell 2000 up 0.3%. Volume was mixed, tracking slightly lower on the NYSE and slightly higher on the Nasdaq vs. Monday, according to preliminary figures.
IBM ( IBM ) led the Dow with a 2.5% gain in the stock market today, following up on Monday's 4% jump. It's still 28% off its 52-week high and 12% below its 60-day moving average. IBM CEO Ginni Rometty bought about $3 million in Big Blue shares, Bloomberg reported Monday. Last week, IBM said it's buying open-source software provider Red Hat ( RHT ) for $34 billion.
Caterpillar ( CAT ) also outperformed with a 2% advance to extend its win streak to six. McDonald's ( MCD ), Boeing ( BA ) and Apple ( AAPL ) also rose more than 1% each. McDonald's, which gained 2% Monday, hit a new high. Boeing padded its small gain above its 50-day line. Apple stemmed a two-session drop during which shares fell more than 9%.
Other leading stocks on the rise included Starbucks ( SBUX ), which rallied 2% to a record high. Shares are now extended from a 62.04 breakout point cleared Friday. It had formed a handle with a 59.80 entry, but since it gapped up Friday, the buy point was moved up to 62.04.
The coffee chain is a Leaderboard member.
Stock Market Today: REITs Rally Again In the IBD 50 , health care REITs rose again, with CareTrust REIT ( CTRE ) and Medical Properties Trust ( MPW ) adding 6% and 2%, respectively. CareTrust cleared an 18.69 correct buy point of a flat base in more than twice normal trade. It remains in buy range from the entry, though keep in mind that all purchases are highly risky with the market in correction.
The San Clemente, Calif.-based REIT on Monday reported Q3 funds from operations that rose 14% to 33 cents a share, in line with views. Revenue jumped 20% to $39.5 million. IBD Stock Checkup assigns CareTrust a 96 Composite Rating, which puts it among the leaders in the 184-stock Finance-Property REIT group.
Among other IBD 50 stocks scoring big gains in the stock market today, Ulta Beauty ( ULTA ) advanced more than 2%. It climbed past a 290.40 buy point of a long saucer with handle, though volume was 8% lower than usual. Ideally you'd see at least a 40% spike in turnover at a solid breakout. The beauty chain was added to Leaderboard Oct. 12 as a half-size position.
Ulta's relative strength line is at 52-week highs, a bullish sign.
The Innovator IBD 50 ETF ( FFTY ) was fractionally higher Tuesday. It's 19% off its Oct. 1 peak.
